items.title: Reproduce the false zombie on a wrapper-root fixture and fix detectZombieStories to list worktrees from the git root
items.context: RED: temp repo with gitRoot configured below the invocation root, a DEV story with a linked worktree; detectZombieStories flags it and session_brief omits it. GREEN: use resolveStoryWorkspace or the configured git root for the worktree list; the same fixture shows the story active.
